findings.message: SkillsAssembler.selectCoreSkills auto-discovers every directory under skills/core, so this new skill is emitted for every profile, but no golden files (or README skill-table updates) were added. GoldenFileTest compares generated vs golden file sets and fails on `extra` files: .claude/skills/x-story-plan/{SKILL.md,README.md,references/planning-guide.md} (plus README index changes) for every profile, so the build is red.

Phase 4.5 (and PO amendments in Rule 5) rewrite the story file after the tasks file is written in 4.1, so mtime(story) > mtime(tasks) after every run. Run /x-story-plan story-0028-0002, then run it again with no story changes: Phase 0.3 sees the story as newer than tasks-story-*.md, logs 'Regenerating stale story plan' and relaunches all 5 agents. The RULE-002 reuse path never fires.

total_checks is computed as mandatory_passed + conditional_applicable, not 10 + conditional_applicable, so the denominator shrinks when mandatory checks fail. With 7 of 10 mandatory checks passing and no conditionals applicable, the summary shows 'Passed: 7/7' while the verdict is NOT_READY. The checklist looks fully passed and contradicts the verdict.

DoR checks 1, 2, 3 and 9 require architecture, test, security and implementation plan files or agent output, but the skill never writes those files. On the reuse path no agents run (line 104), so these checks have nothing to inspect. On the second run, when artifacts are fresh, Phase 0.3 skips straight to Phase 5 and invokes no subagents. With no architecture-/tests-/security-/plan-story files on disk, checks 1, 2, 3 and 9 fail, and an earlier READY story flips to NOT_READY.

The implicit rule 'domain tasks before application before adapter' applies to every task, including SEC/TL/PO verify tasks. Those tasks are told to depend explicitly on the implementation tasks they verify, which can sit in outer layers. SEC-001 (layer: domain, verifies input validation) depends on ARCH-004 (adapter.inbound controller). The implicit rule adds ARCH-004 -> depends on SEC-001, which creates a cycle. Phase 3.4 then aborts with 'Circular dependency detected'.

The QA prompt orders TPP levels as scalar(3), conditional(4), collection(5), iteration(6). Consolidation (line 494) and planning-guide.md order them as scalar, collection, conditional, iteration. QA emits UT tasks with conditional before collection as instructed. Consolidation re-sorts them with collection first, so the final order differs from the QA test plan. DoR check 2 ('UT-N follow TPP ordering 1 through 6') can be judged against either ordering.

The update rule only says to preserve existing Section 8 content and add 8.1 below it. It never says to replace an 8.1 left by a previous run. Running with --force, or the always-stale case caused by finding 2, appends another '### 8.1 Detailed Tasks (generated by x-story-plan)' block each run. The story file then holds several conflicting task lists.
